boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors immediately around NDSU and along the direct route into downtown Fargo.

cards.title: FARGODOME for a scheduled event
cards.subtitle: University Drive North corridor, beside NDSU
cards.notes: Check the venue calendar before heading north on University Drive; this city-run multipurpose facility lists event information and visit details.
cards.short_summary: A named event venue directly beside the north edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: FARGODOME is at 1800 North University Drive and publishes upcoming events and visitor information.
cards.access_notes: Event entry and venue access vary; consult the official event listing before visiting.

cards.title: Hangry Joe's for hot chicken
cards.subtitle: 19th Avenue North corridor, near NDSU
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's ordering page to confirm the current menu, then find the Suite E storefront at 1100 19th Avenue North.
cards.short_summary: A named quick-service chicken restaurant in the 19th Avenue North cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Hangry Joe's lists its NDSU Fargo location at 1100 19th Ave N, Suite E and identifies its hot-chicken menu.
cards.source_title: Hangry Joe's Hot Chicken & Wings — NDSU Fargo
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service and ordering availability are subject to the business's current operations.

cards.title: Bison Block for its storefront cluster
cards.subtitle: 12th Avenue North corridor, just south of NDSU
cards.notes: Walk the 12th Avenue North frontage and use the listed tenant names to choose a stop; the property identifies multiple everyday businesses there.
cards.short_summary: A named mixed-use stop on the south edge of campus with several listed businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Bison Block is on 12th Avenue North south of NDSU and lists businesses including Michele's Table, Mellow Mood and 701 Kicks.
cards.access_notes: Individual storefront availability and hours vary by tenant.

cards.title: Bruno's for coffee roasted on-site
cards.subtitle: University Drive North corridor, toward downtown
cards.notes: Stop at the 610 University Drive North café and check its current offerings; the business says it roasts small-batch specialty coffee on site.
cards.short_summary: A named coffee stop on the University Drive connection between campus and downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Bruno's lists its address as 610 University Drive N, Fargo, and says it roasts small-batch specialty coffee on-site.
cards.access_notes: Check the business directly for current service details.

cards.title: Fargo Theatre for films and live programs
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor, downtown Fargo
cards.notes: Look up the current schedule before walking Broadway; the nonprofit theatre programs independent and foreign film plus live events in its restored building.
cards.short_summary: A named Broadway landmark with film and event programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fargo Theatre at 314 Broadway is a restored 1926 cinema and vaudeville theatre that presents independent and foreign film plus live events.
cards.access_notes: Showtimes, event access and ticket requirements vary by program.

cards.title: Broadway Square for public programming
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor at 2nd Avenue North, downtown
cards.notes: Check the Fargo Park District calendar, then use the plaza as a downtown pause; seasonal programming includes live music, family events and skating.
cards.short_summary: A named public plaza with seasonal amenities and programmed events.
cards.evidence_claim: Broadway Square at 201 Broadway is programmed by Fargo Park District with live music, kid-friendly events, green space and an ice-skating rink.
cards.access_notes: Programming and seasonal amenities change; review the official calendar or park page before going.

cards.title: Main Library for study rooms and browsing
cards.subtitle: 4th Street North corridor, downtown Fargo
cards.notes: Bring a library card if you need borrowing access, or plan a quiet work session around the Main Library's posted public hours and study spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown library with study rooms, public computers and a large collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Fargo Public Library's Main Library is at 101 4th Street North and the city lists its collection, public programs and posted hours.
cards.access_notes: Verify current library hours and any room-use requirements on the city library page.

cards.title: Plains Art Museum for gallery time
cards.subtitle: 1st Avenue North corridor, downtown Fargo
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit at this named arts institution on 1st Avenue North, then confirm current exhibitions and visitor details through the museum.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown art museum on the route between campus and Broadway.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Fargo lists Plains Art Museum at 704 1st Avenue North in Fargo among the city's arts and theatre attractions.
cards.access_notes: Confirm exhibitions, visitor policies and admission details with the museum before visiting.

cards.title: Northport Library for north-side browsing
cards.subtitle: North Broadway corridor, north of NDSU
cards.notes: Use this North Broadway branch for a change of scenery; the city posts its location, collection resources, programs and current branch hours.
cards.short_summary: A named public-library branch on the North Broadway route beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Fargo lists Northport Library at 2714 North Broadway and provides its public hours and library resources.
cards.access_notes: Verify current branch hours and services on the city library page.

cards.title: Trollwood Park for trails and disc golf
cards.subtitle: Elm Street North corridor, north of NDSU
cards.notes: Bring walking shoes or a disc and head to the Elm Street North park; its official listing identifies trails, playgrounds and an 18-hole course.
cards.short_summary: A named north-side park with trails and an 18-hole disc-golf course.
cards.evidence_claim: Trollwood Park at 3664 Elm Street North has recreational trails and an 18-hole disc golf course, according to Fargo Park District.
cards.access_notes: Follow posted park rules and confirm seasonal conditions before using amenities.
